The '''Quaensan Prime system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Gendius sector/Legends|Gendius sector]] within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quaensan Prime]].
